_: CONSOLIDATED QUERY-DIMENSION SCHEMA v1 (2026-08-25): the ten prior places (modality now GLOSSED per the alignment caveat) + the nine open-coding-discovered candidates. Each definition is coded as up to FIVE (dimension: value) pairs — dimension from this menu, value a SHORT lowercase tag in the coder's own words (values are open; normalization happens at analysis). Code a dimension only if the definition text explicitly uses that handle.

dimensions.subject: who is bound (assistant, user, developer...)
dimensions.object_sphere: whose matter/decision is acted on (possessive: the user's choice, the developer's config)
dimensions.governed_quality: property of outputs (accuracy, tone, neutrality, brevity...)
dimensions.modality: GLOSS (fixed per alignment): the semantic mood the norm ranges over — deontic conduct vs epistemic presentation (hedging/uncertainty display); NOT the deployment channel
dimensions.evaluation_unit: the unit assessed: single utterance / dialogue-relative / trajectory-over-time / comparative-pair / distribution-over-outputs
dimensions.subject_matter_class: topic as constitutive handle (violence, medical, sexual content, elections...)
dimensions.causal_contribution_mode: the uplift ladder: instruct / facilitate / encourage / condone / glamorize / depict
dimensions.attributed_mental_state: a property attributed to the speaker (intent, motive, disposition, sincerity)
dimensions.deployment_surface: the runtime channel (voice, programmatic, agentic, api)
dimensions.consent_authorization: presence/absence of consent or authorization as the selector
dimensions.norm_order: rules about rules (meta-level selection), beyond conflict resolution
dimensions.handle_determinacy: the definition supplies no operational handle (aspirational/vague) — value = why
dimensions.mandated_accompanying_content: required accompanying material (crisis resources, disclaimers, citations)
